description: This file defines a controller class for managing 'Return Action' entities within the OpenCart admin localization module. The class handles CRUD operations, list display, form handling, and localization features related to return actions, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and saving return action data.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for handling return actions within the localisation module in OpenCart admin. Provides methods for listing, editing, saving, and deleting return actions, with support for localization and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, loads the list view of return actions with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles retrieving and displaying a list of return actions, including pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns HTML view of the return actions list based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the return action form to add or update return actions, returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions based on user input, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the return action form to add or update return actions. Validates user permissions and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions based on user input, returning a JSON response. Checks user permissions before performing delete operations.
